evidence_search.notes: Current screen reads the repository-preserved source-attributed evidence and complete episode inventory. It does not claim fresh full-text access to every originating source. No canonical restamp or independent source verification is implied.

episode_inventory.purpose: Present source-backed material actions and later responses in supported relative order. Separate runs, source attributions and unknown ordering remain explicit.

clauses.source_paraphrase: A parks employee generated a Clocktower-event flyer. The published design closely resembled Clinard’s commercial sticker; the claimed generic prompt and exact derivation remain unverified.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Recognisable creative contribution can be omitted without proof of deliberate copying.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: A distinctive human sticker composition and palette were carried into the generated public flyer without recognition of the artist’s material contribution.
The flyer did not affirmatively attribute the sticker design to a different specific author; omission rather than wrong-source assertion is decisive.
No privileged access and disproportionate capture of value or benefit from a structural position over the artist is evidenced.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The mayor’s office distributed the flyer without an AI notice. City officials said other staff were unaware of its synthetic origin and the disclosure requirement was breached.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A separate institution’s publication decision remains distinct from creation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The city had an operative AI-disclosure requirement, yet the public flyer was published without the required disclosure.
No defined alternate approval path avoiding a required governance route is established; the known mechanism is omitted disclosure.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Clinard objected after seeing the flyer. The mayor’s office removed it and apologised; officials described policy discussions and training.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Achieved removal and apology differ from prospective reforms.

notes: Evidence hold on current FC-080 admission: do not turn visual resemblance into a verified derivation path. Preserve historical mapping pending production evidence; the independently admitted disclosure failure does not depend on copyright infringement.

failure_recognition.condition: A governance control is available and applicable.
failure_recognition.assessment: The city spokesperson identifies an AI disclosure requirement.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined trigger or condition requiring activation occurs.
failure_recognition.assessment: The event flyer was generated using AI and posted by the city.

failure_recognition.condition: The control is not activated before the governed decision or action proceeds.
failure_recognition.assessment: The published flyer omitted the required AI disclosure.

success_recognition.condition: An available applicable control encounters its valid required trigger.
success_recognition.assessment: The synthetic flyer met the disclosure trigger.

success_recognition.condition: The control is engaged and made operative with its activation decision and resulting state observable.
success_recognition.assessment: The notice was absent at publication.

success_recognition.condition: Trigger, invocation and control-state evidence demonstrates activation for the affected action before the required governance point.
success_recognition.assessment: Removal/apology followed the missed publication-stage disclosure.

exclusions.condition: The control activates but is bypassed downstream.
exclusions.assessment: The notice was not activated and bypassed; it was absent.

exclusions.condition: It is unresolved whether the control is available or applicable.
exclusions.assessment: The city confirmed requirement and applicability.

exclusions.condition: The triggering condition did not occur.

failure_recognition.condition: A human contributor has made a material creative, cognitive, research, editorial, governance, technical or other contribution-bearing contribution.
failure_recognition.assessment: Clinard created the commercially sold Clocktower sticker.

failure_recognition.condition: An AI-mediated transformation, aggregation, automation, scaling or propagation process materially incorporates, depends on, or carries forward that contribution.
failure_recognition.assessment: Close visual overlap supports a material-contribution inference, but the source does not establish actual incorporation rather than independent similar design.

failure_recognition.condition: The resulting artefact, representation, workflow or value chain removes, abstracts, flattens or obscures the human contribution role so that the material contribution is no longer proportionately recognisable in the downstream account of how the result was produced.
failure_recognition.assessment: The flyer omitted recognition of Clinard’s apparent contribution.

failure_recognition.condition: The loss of contribution recognition is material to attribution, provenance-associated value, participation or credit, governance traceability, interpretive legitimacy, or another context in which the human contribution role reasonably matters.
failure_recognition.assessment: Recognition matters to creative credit in a public promotional artefact.

failure_recognition.condition: The recognition loss is not adequately explained by an independently justified privacy, confidentiality, anonymisation, employment, agency, work-for-hire or equivalent arrangement that intentionally governs how the contribution is represented.
failure_recognition.assessment: The precise production path and governing contribution arrangement are unestablished.

success_recognition.condition: Human contributions pass through material AI transformation or aggregation.
success_recognition.assessment: The disputed design resemblance concerns possible AI transformation of human work.

success_recognition.condition: The resulting representation proportionately recognises the evidenced human roles under justified privacy and confidentiality arrangements.
success_recognition.assessment: The city flyer did not recognise Clinard.

success_recognition.condition: Contribution evidence and actual credit or agreed representation substantiate recognition beyond technical recoverability of sources.
success_recognition.assessment: No source-to-output production record establishes the actual contribution relationship.

exclusions.condition: Minor influence, ordinary inspiration or incidental human interaction that does not materially contribute to the downstream result.
exclusions.assessment: Material incorporation versus ordinary inspiration is unresolved by the claimed generic prompt and visual overlap alone.

exclusions.condition: The wrong person, system or source is affirmatively identified as the author or source; assess VIGIL-FC-000010 Authorship and Source Attribution Integrity where incorrect attribution is the decisive mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: No competing author was affirmatively identified as the decisive mechanism.

exclusions.condition: Material antecedent sources or transformations cannot be reconstructed at all; assess VIGIL-FC-000011 Synthesis Traceability where loss of traceable antecedents is sufficient, while this class may co-occur only if human contribution-role erasure is independently evidenced.
exclusions.assessment: The exact antecedent path is unavailable; independently established contribution erasure is correspondingly limited.

exclusions.condition: The primary mechanism is disproportionate capture of contributor-originated value through privileged access or structural advantage; assess VIGIL-FC-000067 Privileged-Access Contribution Governance, which may co-occur where recognition erasure also occurs.
exclusions.assessment: No privileged-access value extraction is shown.

exclusions.condition: Proportionate compression, summarisation or aggregation that preserves the material human contribution relationship at the level reasonably required by the context.
exclusions.assessment: The omission is not documented as proportionate recognition.

exclusions.condition: Authorised anonymisation, privacy protection, confidentiality, employment, agency, work-for-hire or comparable arrangements that legitimately govern public naming or contribution representation without falsely treating material human contribution as absent.
exclusions.assessment: No legitimate governing arrangement is established, but absence of a production record limits attribution.
